name: Duette® Honeycomb Shades
description: Duette® Honeycomb Shades set the standard for energy-efficient window fashions with their patented honeycomb construction that traps air to insulate your home.

benefits.text:
Extensive Offering
Most pleat sizes and opacities are available in every fabric. Choose from 
a broad selection of beautiful colors, as well as operating systems and 
design options, to discover your perfect Duette shade.  
Easy Care and Cleaning
To ensure lasting beauty, all Duette shades are anti-static, dust and 
soil resistant and easy to clean.
Larger Sizes with Small Stack
Duette shades are engineered to provide a low profile when 
fully raised on taller windows, allowing for unobstructed views.
Outstanding UV Protection
Protect your furniture, flooring and artwork from harmful 
UV rays with Duette shades.
Noise Reduction
Duette® shades absorb sound energy, helping to create a more 
tranquil room.
Benefits
Coordinating Headrail Finishes
Textured matte headrails are color coordinated to the fabric for a 
cohesive design.
Sustainable Fabrics
Duette Architella Alexa™ and Thea™ outer cell fabrics are 
innovatively crafted with 90% recycled materials.  
Superior Energy Efficiency
Designed with three insulating pockets, Duette® Architella® shades help 
save more energy at the window, no matter the outdoor climate.

Energy Efficiency
Cost Savings
Shades help control the indoor temperature, so you can spend less to 
heat and cool your home. 
Superior Insulation
An innovative, insulating design features an extra layer that protects your home 
from harsh outdoor temperatures.
Automation Throughout the Year 
PowerView® Automation lets you schedule shades to open and close according to 
the sun’s movements, so your home’s temperature is regulated automatically.
Sustainability
Shades may eliminate a need for artificial lighting by softly diffusing 
natural sunlight within a room.

PowerView® Automation

Vertiglide™ 
For vertical applications such as patio doors, this 
system provides side-to-side operation. Offered in 
four stacking configurations.
SkyLift™*
This system covers large skylights. Available with manual 
or motorized operation in top stack only.
Additional Operating Options
Simplicity™** 
This manual system is designed for skylights and other hard-to-reach 
windows. Can be oriented for top, bottom or side stack.
Vertiglide Split Stack
Shades operate individually.
Vertiglide Left Stack or Right Stack
Left stack opens from right to left. Right stack 
opens from left to right.
Vertiglide Duolite®
A center-opening design combines two opacities 
in one. Each fabric can span the full width of 
the opening.
Vertiglide Traveling Center Stack
Shades open from the sides and stack in the center.
PowerView® Operable Specialty Shapes
Automate high and hard-to-reach arched and angled windows.
*Available in Canada as a Duolite® option only.
**Not available in Canada.

Top-Down/Bottom-Up
Operate shades from top-down or bottom-up to achieve desired level 
of light and privacy. (Top-Down/Bottom-Up not available in Canada)
Streetside Fabric
Architella® Elan® fabrics have an off-white streetside color 
that reflects sunlight and provides a more neutral look.
Design Options
Pleat Size and Construction
Choose from a wide selection of pleat sizes and constructions, 
ensuring the best product for your needs. 
Specialty Shapes
Easily cover windows in your home that have unusual shapes or sizes.
Doors and Sidelights
Duette® shades are an ideal solution for French doors and sidelights.
Two-On-One Headrail
Two independently operated shades can share the same headrail. 
LightLock® and LightLock Flex
The LightLock® and LightLock Flex system utilizes channels with specially 
shaped micro-ridges to absorb and deflect incoming light.
TrackGlide™ with LiteRise®
For European-style tilt-turn windows or French Doors, this operating 
system keeps shades in place during window operation.
